featured_reviews.name: Rijul Chindarkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently underwent surgery for a deviated septum with Dr. Jyotsna Jagtap, and I couldn’t be more satisfied with the entire experience. From the very first consultation, she explained everything clearly and made me feel completely comfortable and confident about the procedure.

The surgery went absolutely seamlessly  there was no pain during the procedure, and my recovery has been smooth with excellent results. I can genuinely feel the improvement in my breathing.

Her team of nurses was extremely cooperative, attentive, and supportive throughout. The overall care and coordination were outstanding. I would highly recommend Dr. Jyotsna Jagtap to anyone looking for an experienced and compassionate ENT surgeon.
